description: This file defines a React component 'TenantBootstrapGate' that acts as a routing gate in a React application. It ensures that 'TenantBootstrap' logic executes before rendering nested routes, by wrapping route components with a React fragment containing 'TenantBootstrap' and an 'Outlet'. It also contains comments detailing requirement traceability and design considerations.

methods.name: TenantBootstrapGate()
methods.description: A React functional component that renders 'TenantBootstrap' and an 'Outlet' within a React fragment to serve as a routing gate.
